mechanism_narrative: The -21.1 point collapse in RETAIL_REC last week reflects a sustained drop in retail footfall that does not mean-revert; RETAIL_REC continues lower over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days by more than 5 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT falls more than 20 points week-on-week, crossing a mobility-collapse threshold; the transit ridership collapse removes commuter foot traffic that supports retail-and-recreation, so RETAIL_REC declines over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls more than 20 percentage points week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days when TRANSIT falls more than 20 percentage points week-on-week.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in GROCERY_PHARM and decline in WORKPLACES indicates households divert trips to essential shopping and stay home from work; this interaction suppresses discretionary retail-and-recreation over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM > +5 and WORKPLACES < -10 in same week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days during weeks with GROCERY_PHARM > +5 and WORKPLACES < -10.

mechanism_narrative: Under tightening restrictions, WORKPLACES falls below -13 and RESIDENTIAL rises above +5.9, showing non-essential workers are ordered home; retail-and-recreation mobility falls further over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days under stay-at-home restrictions.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS drops from +7.1 to -1.3 in the latest week even as spring begins, signaling outdoor recreation is suppressed; reduced parks activity spills over to lower retail-and-recreation trips over the next week.
candidate_trigger: PARKS falls more than 5 percentage points week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days when PARKS falls more than 5 percentage points week-on-week.

mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES declines from +2.4 to -13.1 in one week, signaling a sudden loss of office-based foot traffic; this reduces adjacent retail-and-recreation visits and pulls RETAIL_REC down over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days when WORKPLACES is below -10.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM mobility is above baseline while RETAIL_REC is deeply negative, indicating trip substitution toward essentials; as long as GROCERY_PHARM stays positive, discretionary RETAIL_REC remains below its last 28-day mean over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days while GROCERY_PHARM is positive.

mechanism_narrative: The joint collapse of TRANSIT and WORKPLACES creates a mobility sink that pulls RETAIL_REC down over the next four weeks; neither series shows mean reversion under tightening restrictions.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days when TRANSIT < -20 and WORKPLACES < -10.
